_comment_scan_interval: Seconds between each memory scan iteration; lower = more responsive but higher CPU usage.
_comment_key_press_delay: Seconds to wait between each key-down/key-up event when sending a key sequence.
_comment_player_name_signature: FFXIVClientStructs PlayerState::Instance(). hit+3 is RIP-relative disp32 to a PlayerState instance embedded directly in .data (not a pointer to one); player name is UTF-8 char[] at instance+0x01, NUL-terminated. Player name is empty / zeros until login.
